info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Human Resource Management Recruitment-spec
info.description: The Human Resource Management Recruitment API enables organizations to streamline their recruitment processes. This API allows users to create and manage recruitment specifications, ensuring alignment with business needs. Typical consumers include HR professionals and recruitment specialists who require an efficient solution for specification management. Use cases may involve setting up new job postings, defining role requirements, and streamlining the recruitment workflow.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to start a new recruitment process within the human resource management system. It collects necessary details for the role being recruited for and handles the submission of recruitment requests.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new recruitment entry in the human resource management system. It requires details about the job position, candidate information, and other relevant data necessary for the recruitment process.
